blocking_findings: The frozen artifact set omitted the transitive EconCSLib Lean import closure and Lake dependency state.
The timestamped run-root launcher did not durably enforce one attempt per matrix cell or the frozen execution order before model access.
Lean-check evidence did not record guidance hashes in a protected sequence, so it could not establish that a guidance change followed a genuine Lean failure.
The route prompts contradicted themselves by allowing only Candidate.lean edits while also requiring a learned-guidance edit.
records.disposition: DEV-001 is invalidated in full before execution. Its checkpoint commit, detached protocol hash, and original Codex AI review remain historical evidence. Repairs are frozen under DEV-002; no DEV-001 result exists or may be pooled with DEV-002.
